company.name: Filkhedma
company.shortDescription: FilKhedma provides maintenance services for homes and offices in Egypt.
company.description: FilKhedma is the largest home services marketplace in Egypt. Users can book online quality guaranteed reliable service providers in home cleaning, maintenance and other services. Service providers apply online and are accepted after passing through the onboarding process after which they receive orders through a mobile app. The service operates in 3 Egyptian cities.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $1,003,675 to $6,231,924, a 6.21x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 52 (-1 over 90 days) and market heat at 37 (+3).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
